engine.game_code_build: us (NALE) — one build serves every supported region

supported_roms.file_ids: native (the port's game code is the US build)

mapping.method: monotone alignment of the EU reloc table against the US file-id table over (decompressed size, internal reloc pointer count, external reloc pointer count)
mapping.id_step_function: eu_id - us_id is non-decreasing and rises by exactly 17, matching the file-count difference: the European build inserts released-language variants next to the files they localise
mapping.remaining_differences: 25 localised menu/scene/name files (MN*, SC*, CharacterNames, MiscData029) whose European content is larger; their ids are pinned by identical-fingerprint anchors on both sides
mapping.extern_references: 44 of 3372 external reloc references point at Europe-only files; every one of them comes from another Europe-only file, so nothing the engine loads depends on them (tools/eu_extern_probe.py)

unsupported_roms.note: needs an engine built with -DSSB64_VERSION=jp; the Japanese reloc table (0x1ACAF0, 2107 files) and yamls/jp exist, but the launcher only accepts the US and European ROMs.
